create_transform_normalize: create a Normalize transform to standardize tensor image channels with given mean and std
build_transform_resize: build a Resize transform to scale images and proportionally adjust bounding box coordinates
test_normalize_call: test the Normalize class __call__ method to normalize a torch tensor image
test_resize_call: test the Resize class __call__ method to resize an image and scale bounding boxes
review_transforms_module: review the transforms module containing Normalize and Resize data augmentation classes
